item.title: Inquiry into antisemitism in Australia condemns online hatred and bigotry targeting witnesses
item.description: The head of an inquiry into antisemitism in Australia has condemned online hatred and bigotry targeting Jewish witnesses

item.title: UAE accused of training Colombian mercenaries for Sudan's war
